task_description: Three sequenced follow-ups on the pantry repo's verify-pantry work: (2a) fix the stale frontend/e2e Playwright specs + helpers so they match the real current UI and pass; (2b) add three proven verify-pantry drivers (flagged-resolution, stock-out oldest-first, shopping-list) mirroring drive-stock-in.mjs and prove each green via pantry-verify.sh, updating the feature docs; (2c) wire the e2e suite into CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml) to run on PRs, safely (specific env vars only, merged via PR by the orchestrator). Order matters: 2a establishes the confirmed selectors that 2b and 2c depend on.
